problem: Exact-source Netlify fallback uploads can return 401 Unauthorized even though OIDC proxy acquisition succeeded earlier in the same production snapshot job.
root_cause: The Netlify MCP proxy is short-lived. It was acquired before linked-build/provider polling and then reused later for the exact-source fallback upload, so the credential could expire before @netlify/mcp used it.
prevention_rule: Refresh GitHub OIDC and obtain a new Netlify MCP proxy immediately before every exact-source fallback upload; never reuse the earlier proxy across provider polling. Exact-main provider identity and browser readback remain mandatory.
prevention: Refresh the OIDC-backed Netlify MCP proxy immediately before every exact-source fallback upload.
Do not reuse a proxy across a potentially long linked-build/provider-watch phase.
Keep exact-main commit_ref proof and browser readback as terminal gates.
Classify fallback 401 as transport credential expiry rather than a site build failure.

evaluation.expected_invariant: a fresh OIDC-backed Netlify MCP proxy is acquired immediately before exact-source fallback upload
